heroSummary: Northshore School District starts school for most grades on Wednesday, September 3, 2025. Winter Break runs December 22 through January 2, Mid-Winter Break runs February 17–20 after Presidents Day, and Spring Break runs April 6–10. The scheduled last day is Wednesday, June 17, 2026, unless emergency make-up days extend the school year.

schemaDatasetDescription: Reviewed Northshore School District dates for 2025–26, including first and last school days, Wednesday early release, elementary conference early dismissals, Winter Break, Mid-Winter Break, Spring Break, teacher grading/non-student day, commencement-related early dismissals, and emergency make-up days.
calendarNotes: The NSD 2025–26 Family Calendar marks September 3 as the first day for most grades. Wednesday early release begins September 10 and dismisses students 1.5 hours early unless noted. Elementary conference early dismissals appear on specific November dates and February 6. January 26 is a teacher grading/non-student day. Graduation week includes commencement dates and early dismissals for grades 9-11 at specific high schools. Emergency make-up days may be added to the end of the year if needed.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the first day of school for NSD in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: Northshore School District lists Wednesday, September 3, 2025, as the first day of school for most grades.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Wednesday early release start in NSD for 2025–26?
calendarFaqs.a: Wednesday early release begins September 10, 2025. NSD states that all Wednesdays beginning September 10 dismiss 1.5 hours early for students unless noted.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Spring Break for NSD in 2026?
Can the 2025–26 NSD last day change?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. The scheduled last day is June 17, 2026, but NSD lists June 18, June 22, and June 23 as emergency make-up days if needed.

customSections.label: What NSD Families Should Know
customSections.content: The 2025–26 NSD calendar includes weekly early release, elementary-only conference dismissals, and emergency make-up days that families should not treat as ordinary school days.

groups.label: Wednesday early release begins September 10
items: All Wednesdays beginning September 10 dismiss 1.5 hours early for students unless noted.
Schools communicate first-day, last-day, and half-day schedules directly to families.

groups.label: Elementary conference dates are not districtwide closures
items: Elementary schools have early dismissals for conferences on November 18, November 20–21, November 24–25, and February 6 by invite.
Secondary families should check school-level calendars for separate schedule changes.
